scripts.dev:worker: cd services/worker && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:jobs: cd services/worker && uv run watchfiles --sigint-timeout 10 "python worker.py" app worker.py
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm run typecheck:worker
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:tokens && pnpm run lint:format && pnpm run lint:worker
scripts.lint:worker: cd services/worker && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:worker
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd services/worker && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.gen:types: mkdir -p apps/web/types && supabase gen types --lang typescript --local --schema public > apps/web/types/database.ts
